_about: Six real-style briefs for the live Gemini evals (python -m tests.evals.run_evals). `expect` is what intake must read from the text; `fill` completes anything intake left for the user to answer; `start_in_days` is relative to the day the evals run.

briefs.name: telugu_wedding
briefs.text: Telugu wedding for my younger brother in Hyderabad, March 2027, around 600 guests, budget 40 lakhs. We want pellikoduku, haldi, the muhurtham and a reception, with traditional banana leaf meals.

briefs.name: north_indian_wedding
briefs.text: Daughter's wedding in Jaipur on 6 February 2027. About 450 guests, 35 lakh budget. Haldi, mehendi, sangeet with a DJ, the pheras and a reception.

briefs.name: hinglish_input
briefs.text: Bhai ki shaadi hai Delhi mein, April 2027 mein, lagbhag 300 log aayenge, budget 18 lakh ke aas paas hai. Sangeet aur reception dono karna hai.

briefs.name: fifth_birthday
briefs.text: My son's 5th birthday party in Pune on 14 March 2027. 40 kids and 30 adults, budget 60,000 rupees, jungle theme, cake and a magician.

briefs.name: society_ganesh
briefs.text: Ganesh Chaturthi celebration for our housing society in Mumbai, September 2027, for about 500 residents. The committee has collected 3 lakh from members. Pandal, aarti, prasad and a cultural evening.

briefs.name: wedding_three_weeks_away
briefs.text: My cousin's wedding is three weeks from today in Indore, about 250 guests, 12 lakh budget. Nothing is booked yet, please help.
